data.summary:
The layouts show the **terrain features** of the Battlefields: Armageddon box, built in its ‘Warhammer recommended’ configuration, each marked **dense** or **light**.

- Layouts are built so that **[Hidden](vsdata:core-rule/hidden)** and unit movement rules matter and battles offer interesting decisions.
- Each **terrain feature** is set back from the edge of its **terrain area**, so a line of models can stand on the area from outside.
- Without that kit, use your own scenery of about the same size, and tell all players which pieces are **dense** and which **light**.

detail.placement: gap between feature and area edge accommodates models approaching from outside

substitution.density: identify each feature as dense or light
